text: no dont delete it just untrack it i dont need to track the backup
resolution: User asked to untrack (not delete) the compact-store backups under cart/hmsc-int/data. The backups were never actually tracked, but were showing up in git status and at risk of accidental commit. Added two .gitignore patterns (cart/hmsc-int/data/**/_precompact_backup/ and _compact_backup/) in the existing hmsc-int persistence section, matching at any depth — this covers the top-level ~727MB _precompact_backup/model.store.db.bak and the nested domains/model/_compact_backup. Verified via git check-ignore (all backup paths now matched) and git status (no backups appear). The backup files remain on disk as a recovery net. Committed and pushed; local main == origin/main. Also reconciled the user's 27MB-vs-800MB confusion: live model store.db is 27M, the 800M was the stale pre-compaction .bak now ignored. Noted the pre-existing tracked tools/v8cli (55MB, GH001 soft warning, intentional).
